business_summary: American Battery Technology Company operates a commercial-scale lithium-ion battery recycling facility in Nevada that shreds spent batteries and manufacturing scrap into black mass, then refines that black mass hydrometallurgically to recover battery metals domestically. Black mass sales are the majority of the company's revenue, which is still ramping from a near-zero base (FY2024 revenue $343,500 to FY2026 revenue $21,741,726, per SEC companyfacts).

exposure_summary.narrative: ABAT sits on three links of this chain (recycling-and-refining-capacity-buildout, black-mass-production, us-black-mass-refining), all sourced to the same fiscal Q4 2026 8-K exhibit stating black mass sales are the majority of revenue. Revenue is real and growing fast off a tiny base but the company remains deeply loss-making (FY2026 operating loss $74.7M against $21.7M revenue) and operating cash flow negative.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: The 8-K exhibit states black mass sales are 'the majority' of revenue but does not disclose an exact percentage; no other sourced figure was found this run.
